verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS feedback platform like Canny, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers SDK install, SSO, integrations, the MCP server and a staging workspace, but nothing documents retention settings, deletion controls, or data purge capabilities. The API reference title and MCP workflow actions (update statuses, organize requests) say nothing about deletion or retention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
